profile.tool: Valgrind3.22.0 Callgrind, ordinary CLI, default instruction simulation; taskset -c3; separate from timing
profile.interpretation: Instruction shares, not CPU-time shares; inclusive paths overlap and must not be summed. LTO source-frame attribution names inlined functions by their caller context.
profile.original_book_scope: Original930cc4d CLI on identical book input; retained original profile from first layout investigation

audited_late_book_allocations.scope: Existing late-suffix execution/publication boundary audit, not rerun in this cumulative milestone. Fixed input emits UMBER:600:END; restore alone has zero allocation requests.
audited_late_book_allocations.interpretation: Current boundary behavior; no change to pool capacity, message ownership, or checkpoint policy requested or measured here.

comparison_limits: Short shared-host complete processes, warm input/resource caches; medians and all samples retained, no universal parity claim.
Mixed has no original930cc4d timing in this milestone.
Native and Umber output endpoints differ; no PDF backend, automatic hyphenation, math, package/format loading, or custom output routine.
Earlier expansion-only comparisons execute a different feature scope and cannot establish a layout regression.
No production edits or broad Cargo test rerun for measurement/report-only changes.
reproduction: Build ordinary release CLI and library at03148ba with default features; preserve original930cc4d release binary (its SHA matches layout-native.json).
Reuse target/benchmark/layout/{book,narrow,dense}.tex with recorded original hashes; generate from930cc4d documentation only if reconstructing, never from changed current documentation.

process_usage_diagnostic.order: alternate current/pdftex within each sequential pair; no original rerun
process_usage_diagnostic.scope: Separate complete-process user/system usage diagnostic on unchanged ordinary binaries and fixed inputs; no new instruction-profile run and no RSS measurement.
process_usage_diagnostic.fields: user_cpu_seconds=wait4.ru_utime; system_cpu_seconds=wait4.ru_stime; cpu_seconds=sum; minor_page_faults=wait4.ru_minflt; wall_seconds=elapsed process time
process_usage_diagnostic.identity: CLI/native hashes and every source/font hash equal main current milestone. No production code changed. Existing exact native placement/output/replay checks remain applicable; each new process final counter message and exit status checked.
process_usage_diagnostic.medians: Each field is independently median-reduced; user/system medians need not sum to median total.
interpretation: Per-field medians are descriptive and are not additive; use arithmetic mean component differences for an additive comparison across the same seven pairs.
System CPU and minor-fault counts are higher for current Umber in all four cases. In the original three, current mean user CPU is lower than native; the system CPU excess offsets that advantage.
Mixed mean total excess is 5.632 ms, composed of 4.365 ms user and 1.267 ms system CPU. These are whole-process costs, not an engine-only phase attribution.

System-time ranges are wide on these short shared-host processes; minor faults do not identify which buffers/backing paths cause the time. No RSS measurement or kernel/backing causal attribution is made.
